---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible issue in AI Repair Kit
---

## Environment

- AI Repair Kit version
- Windows edition and build
- Codex Windows MSIX version, if relevant

## Expected and observed behavior

Describe what should happen and what happened. State whether you observed it in AI Repair Kit, Codex App Server, or the Codex Desktop screen.

## Reproduction

List the steps using synthetic data if possible. For recovery issues, say whether the failure was in diagnosis, preview, approval, verification, or rollback.

Share redacted summaries or synthetic fixtures only. Keep profiles, cache files, SQLite files, backups, transcripts, credentials, raw logs, and personal paths out of the issue. For a security issue, see [the security policy](https://github.com/CGI07/ai-repair-kit/security/policy).
